posts.post: it’s bizarre how many brands prioritize a loud graphic over the actual drape of the fabric.
there is no greater fashion heartbreak than a piece you love losing its structure after the first dry clean.
the most honest version of your style is what you reach for when you're late and don't have time to think.

we spent two weeks sourcing a specific cotton just because the weight felt slightly off in the hand.

most people won't notice, but i would.
